Lina: Need a concise battlecard refresh for Wed webinar. Focus: cloud AI platforms + infra vendors. Must include: livebench topline, launch post bullets, SDR routing rules. Who owns what?
Rohit: In take the launch post + 3 bullets. Need verified bench numbers. @metrics-bot can you pull latest 95pct & cost deltas?
metrics-bot: Last run (Q1): 95th-latency delta vs multi-tenant cloud: median 2.2x lower at 8k tokens (batch 8); cost-per-token improvement 18-28% with prefix cache + batching.
Becca: Draft headline idea: "Predictable inference: fast, cheaper, and portable." Short bullets: latency, cost, predictable capacity & SLA.
Omar: Add a reliability line: automatic model fallbacks + regional failover keep apps online during contention. Customers prefer graceful degradation over peak bragging rights.
Kai: SDR routing rule (proposal): if ARR>200k OR monthly_tokens>400k -> AE; else SDR. Tags: DedicatedEligible, LatencyPain. Quick SDR script: "Do you have 99th latency SLOs under 500ms? Is GPU spend blocking scale?"
Becca: Rebut template for sales: Claim / Why they say it / Our counter (bench snippet + 90s demo) / Ask. Example: Claim: "Cloud has simpler infra" -> Counter: "We give unified API + managed routing + cost predictability without DIY ops" + demo steps.
Rohit: For launch post — I'll draft and PR by Thurs. Need a 1-paragraph benchmark caveat: test rig, model family, batch/seq, baseline SKU, margin.
Lina: Action items: Rohit = post draft; Becca = rebut templates + demo checklist; Omar = procurement FAQ (SLAs, dedicated terms); Kai = SDR play + routing rules. Due Friday EOD. We'll sync Monday to finalize deck.
Kai: I'll also add sample routing tags for HubSpot and trigger rules.
metrics-bot: Note: top noisy verticals last q: fintech, healthcare, ad-tech. 14 trials cited latency as top blocker.
Lina: Great. If we lock language by Friday we can show sales a preview next week. Thanks team.
